# Private one-SPLICE convergence experiment

Input: immutable `build/cache-editor-product/20261026T035310363807Z/fixture`.
No production source/build/catalog changes. New private C40 and R34 images are
sealed against the exact91de/eaccc1 resident and imported by the real loader.
Both use existing owner4 workspace; no resident BSS/ZP/object/bank is added.
The normal54 catalog becomes56 only inside the private CPU fixture.

```
python3 tests/test_cache_splice.py --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T035310363807Z/fixture
python3 src/cache/splice-probe/build.py build/splice-compile-private build/cache-editor-product/20261026T035310363807Z/fixture
```

## Supported authority

Exactly one real observer SPLICE, insertion1/delete0, same docgeneration and
currentticket=baseline+1/visibleREV=before+1, no wrap. The old complete baseline
must describe committed bytes, have no journal dependency, and contain1..42CRs
in its actual page1. Three source capabilities, epochs, committed length and
source revision must bind the old baseline to a fresh actual R14 lease. Every
STEP checks the live descriptor/ring/event and full actual source identity.

The edit must be strictly inside a real CR-terminated ordinary prose line.
Its existing completed INLINE certificate must have count0 and NULLref. Only
letters/digits/spaces and simple punctuation are accepted during the *complete*
new line scan; stars, @, escape/fence/heading syntax and inserted CR refuse.
The actual SuperMark block parser is initialized at that verified line's source
START with its authenticated incoming6 carry (the same init/at_line protocol as
the existing producer). It consumes actual merged-source packets, <=32 feeds
per public call. New kind/START/BODY/END/NEXT and outgoing6 carry must converge.
No host semantic record, source identity or fake parser checkpoint is seeded.

This is deliberately not general insert/delete/replace, EOF-line, markup or
multi-event rebase. A conservative refusal preserves source/history and the
previous baseline/unread observer event. Other kinds and larger CR populations
remain later work. No general edit-performance or product UI claim is made.

## Explicit base/live representation

Old root and **all old CR bytes/tickets** stay unchanged. A new root has flags3
(COMPLETE|singleSPLICE mapping), live TICKET, baseline OLDEST, journal COUNT1,
full current actual59 source identity and INDEXref=(page15,slot0,gen1). The
standard product classifier rejects this unknown feature rather than accepting
reticketed records. The private read-only query has explicit support only.

Typed page15 holds a128B `SPM1` mapping manifest followed by the96B fresh dirty
record. Baseline writer allocate() refuses page15 (max14), and this prototype
also requires directory15 initially empty and baseline INDEX NULL. This is a
checked logical-page offset in the existing type53 object, never a physical
bank assumption. Page15 is not FE/font/preview space. No extra object is needed.
After cancellation late enough to publish its orphan directory, another attempt
conservatively refuses; recovery/reclamation is not claimed.

Manifest includes base/live tickets, dirtyref, old/new canonical boundaries,
+1 delta, authenticated incoming/outgoing carry, old/new recordCRC, actual32B
event, old root CRC/sequence/slot, and its ownCRC. The original root remains
available as the baseline witness. Query checks root/page/record/manifest CRCs,
current actual59 source, baseline root and actual durable journal. It returns
prefix coordinates unchanged, the new dirty CR at live ticket, and suffix START
shifted+1 while preserving relative END/BODY/NEXT/inline ranges and base ticket.
S_ORIGIN=0 marks unchanged baseline authority,1 the new dirty record; the
returned derived-coordinate CRC does not overwrite its stored baseline record.
All57 source boundaries in the56B real edited fixture are independently checked
against host SuperMark classification, including CR and terminal EOF ownership.

## Transaction / cancellation

Publication: shadow manifest+dirty record, page header VALID0, directory VALID0,
page VALID1, directory VALID1, journal VALID0, journal A5, alternate root VALID0,
root VALID1, then retire the one RAM event without yielding. Every transfer uses
actual typed object guards; after R14 changes the global object request token,
R34 restores/revalidates the arena immediately before its DMA. Actual source and
transport R-slot calls are sequential, never R/R or C/C nested.

Whole16MiB writes are restricted to alternate128B root, directory[0178,0180),
journal[0900,0920), and shadowpage[F000,F120). Source/history/clipboard/unrelated
REU, oldroot and entire oldCRpage remain exact; queries are whole16MiB read-only.
Owner4 protects BC_FRAME576 plus scratch8880..8B3F. Actual79B parser is at8D5E;
saved FS86 at8DAD matches existing resident missing-worker cleanup. GP_CONTROL
9134..9177 and diagnostic8800..887F are not used.

Ops C40:0buildBEGIN,1STEP,2CANCEL,3mappedQUERYBEGIN (input24 at8B20). A1pending,
A0complete, A2unsupported, Cseterror. OutputCR96 at BC_FRAME+291 is provisional
until A0. Private R34 transport ops0..8 are internal; generic checked metadata
reads expose no arbitrary CPU destination. Every image checks owner4 first.
Plain BEGIN/QUERY refuses before any frame write; cancellation remains available
if presentation changes while a job is active.

The gate covers14 cancel/publication checkpoints,4 unsupported marker/CR edits,
missing R14/R34, source-revision change, corrupted owned state,24 foreign-owner
calls and Plain refusal. No native or production dispatcher integration is
claimed. Full initial baseline cost and repeated metadata/source guards are not
hidden; this experiment establishes authority and convergence, not a latency SLA.

## Production promotion requirements (not implemented)

1. Feature3-aware read routing is mandatory for C35/C37/C39 and any inline/lexer
   consumers. They must authenticate base/live tickets, journal and the mapping,
   never compare all old CRs to the live ticket or silently accept flags3 as1.
   Until then legacy C35's actual C2 refusal is intentional; this is not a
   drop-in UI fastpath. Parent owns a safe MISS/fallback policy and layout/job
   admission, including missing-C40-safe resident cleanup/REQ40 continuation.
2. Preserve root copy-on-write: oldroot, oldpages and unread event survive every
   error; reachable newpage+journal must precede rootVALID; retire RAM afterward.
   Give directory15 an explicit allocation/reclaim contract beyond this private
   baseline writer's max14 rule. Current cancellation may leave an unreachable
   directory/page and subsequent attempts conservatively refuse.
3. This transaction cannot be applied again to flags3/COUNT1. Supporting another
   edit or a following representation-only flush needs explicit composed map/
   journal authority, REKEY handling and ticket continuity. It must not reticket
   unrelated CRs or force a baseline as if that were edit reuse.
4. Reuse is classification-only. Rebuild dirty-line actual geometry/styles and
   invalidate or transform layout/viewport caches under separate epochs before
   painting. The private test does not paint a production GEOS page through the
   new root; it compares every source-boundary classification independently.
5. Two extra private assets fit separately (C40/R34), but production registration,
   cold filename/table bytes, resident routing/owner arbitration, stack proof,
   all-mode/source/REU gates and native timing are unbudgeted. No assets, BSS,
   root control flow or cold bytes were silently added to production here.

## Released private gate

Run ordinary and nonzero-region-carry variants:

```
python3 tests/test_cache_splice.py
python3 tests/test_cache_splice.py --region
```

Final pair is C403909B (187spare) +R344082B (14spare). Both independent builds
produce identical bytes. Ordinary56B and region79B edited sources have57/80
canonical-boundary query comparisons; the latter really restores incoming
`00 00 01 00 00 00` and matches that outgoing region carry. Each parses23 dirty
line bytes. Both25-group fault matrices pass, including Plain change across a
held source lease. Bridge costs are198784/215486 CPU instructions, peaks62548/
62547 including first cold image admission. These are CPU instructions, not PAL
cycles, nor a complete UI-edit latency measurement. Publicedit setup still uses
the current production fallback before the private bridge is invoked.
